card.does: Rolls the robot along the floor.
card.needs: Needs: a shaft to turn it (grey).
card.popularMechanics: Cars, prams and shopping trolleys all ride on wheels like this.

failureModes.cardLine: Not on a shaft: the wheel does not drive.
failureModes.hint: This wheel needs a shaft to turn it
failureModes.teachingNote: A wheel only drives when a shaft turns it. Without a drive linkage it just rolls along, pushed by the frame.

failureModes.cardLine: Slipping: the wheel spins but the robot stays put.
failureModes.hint: This wheel is spinning in place
failureModes.teachingNote: A wheel pushes only as hard as its tyre grips the floor. Asked for more, up a steep ramp or against a heavy box, it spins in place.
